info.name: Select Star Metadata bi custom-attributes-with-value API

params.name: asset_type
params.description: A comma separated value for asset type in form: data_source_type,object_type,data_type

params.name: data_source_types
params.description: A list of comma separated types to filter these custom attributes for.

params.name: data_types
params.description: A list of comma separated types to filter these custom attributes for.

params.name: object_types
params.description: A list of comma separated types to filter these custom attributes for.

params.name: page
params.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

items.docs:
The GUID in the path is for the object that the custom attribute is assigned to (like a table, column, etc).
This endpoint returns all the custom attributes tied to this object, along with their corresponding values.

**Required Role:** Viewer or higher
